capabilities: Reads receipt photos and notes with AI services
Drafts ledger entries for review before saving
Imports bank and payment app CSV statements
Tracks budgets, refunds, transfers and exchange rates
Exports the ledger to CSV and charts spending
disambiguation: Not a full accounting system: it tracks expenses only, with no income or account balances.
extras: Free, MIT, no account or analytics. API keys stay in Obsidian secret storage and are not synced; receipt images/text go only to your chosen AI services, and only currency pair plus date go to frankfurter.app. Inbox folders auto-send files to the AI service; needs Obsidian 1.13+; plugin id changed from ai-accounting-plugin in 0.4.0.
problem: Obsidian has no expense ledger, so receipt photos and notes must be transcribed by hand into Markdown tables.

relations.evidence: DeepSeek is suggested first; pick another service if you like
OpenAI, and any other OpenAI-compatible or local server
Free, from frankfurter.app, cached in the plugin folder

requires.name: AI service API key (e.g. DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini) for receipt reading

summary: Expense ledger that turns receipt photos and notes into multi-currency Markdown, with AI-drafted entries you review before saving, budgets, charts and CSV.
